triggers.name: new_updated_object
triggers.title: New or updated object
triggers.description: New or updated records in SuccessFactors
triggers.help: Retrieve the details of any record via its key columns. Provide value for all key columns, as the action will error out when there is no match.

input.name: ___poll_interval

input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any SuccessFactors object. Note that only objects with date fields are supported, For example, User .

input.name: key_column
input.label: Object unique key
input.hint: Select unique key column. For example, UserId .

input.name: since

input.label: As of date
input.hint: Pick a date or enter it in MM/DD/YYYY format. You must not use "as of date" together with “from date” or “to date”. Note: This field is not supported for Odata V4.

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.description: Custom action in SAP SuccessFactors OData (Custom)
actions.help: Build your own SuccessFactors action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your SuccessFactors connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: advance_search_object
actions.title: Search records using OData query
actions.description: Search records using OData query in SuccessFactors
actions.help: Retrieve a list of records that match specified OData query.

input.name: object_name
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the SuccessFactors object. For example, User .

input.name: filter
input.label: Query
input.hint: Filter condition which needs be used to filter. For example, effectiveStartDate eq datetime'2019-11-05T00:00:00' and externalCode eq '54676' .

input.name: select_fields
input.label: Output fields
input.hint: Enter the output fields you want to be returned separated by comma. If left blank, Workato will fetch all available fields in the selected record.

input.name: top
input.label: Page size
input.hint: Maximum number of records to be returned as part of the response. Default value: 100 . Maximum allowed limit is 1000 .

input.name: skip
input.label: Offset
input.hint: Number of records to skip in the retrieval. Default value: 0 . Example: 100

input.name: orderby
input.label: Order by
input.hint: Order the collection of entries. For example: lastModified asc or lastModified or lastModified desc .

input.name: fromDate
input.label: From date
input.hint: Pick a starting date to return records from or enter it in MM/DD/YYYY format. SuccessFactors returns records from “From date” to the effective “To date“. You must not use “from date” together with “as…

input.name: toDate
input.label: To date
input.hint: Pick an ending date to return records to or enter it in MM/DD/YYYY format. SuccessFactors returns records from “From date” to the effective “To date“. You must not use “to date” together with “as of d…

input.name: asOfDate
input.label: As of date
input.hint: Pick a date or enter it in MM/DD/YYYY format. You must not use "as of date" together with “from date” or “to date”. Note: This field is not supported for Odata V4.

actions.name: create_object
actions.title: Create record
actions.help: Creates a new record in SuccessFactors with provided values for selected object.

input.name: object_name
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any SuccessFactors object. For example, User .

actions.name: get_object
actions.title: Get record details
actions.help: Retrieve the details of any record via its key columns. Provide value for all key columns, otherwise it returns error when there is no match.

input.name: object_name
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any SuccessFactors object. For example, User .

actions.name: merge_object
actions.title: Merge record
actions.help: Merge only the properties provided in the request body, and leave data not mentioned in the request body as is. Note: This action only supports Odata V2.

input.name: object_name
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any SuccessFactors object. For example, User .

input.name: key_column
input.label: Object unique key
input.hint: Select unique key column. For example, UserId .

actions.name: search_object
actions.title: Search records
actions.help: The Search records action returns results that match all your search criteria. Select the SuccessFactors object to search for, then specify at least one field to match.

input.name: object_name
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the SuccessFactors object. For example, User .

actions.name: update_object
actions.title: Update record
actions.help: Updates the record with the provided input values. If no data provided for any field, its value is set to their default value.

input.name: object_name
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any SuccessFactors object. For example, User .

input.name: key_column
input.label: Object unique key
input.hint: Select unique key column. For example, UserId .

actions.name: upsert_object
actions.title: Upsert records (single object)
actions.help: Search for record in SuccessFactors by a specified field (primary key). If found, update it with the data being provided to the action. If not found, create it with the data being provided to the action. This action processes up to 200 records. Note: This action only supports Odata V2.

input.name: object_name
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any SuccessFactors object. For example, User .

actions.name: upsert_record_object
actions.title: Upsert record
actions.help: Search for record in SuccessFactors by a specified field (primary key). If found, update it with the data being provided to the action. If not found, create it with the data being provided to the action.

input.name: object_name
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any SuccessFactors object. For example, User .

actions.name: upsert_records_transactional
actions.title: Upsert records (multiple objects)
actions.help: This action allows simultaneous operation of single or multiple objects. It follows transactional behavior, i.e. failure of a single operation causes the whole batch to fail. For more information please read SAP documentation . Note: This action only supports Odata V2.

input.name: object_names
input.label: Objects
input.hint: Select any SuccessFactors objects. For example, User,EmpJob .
